أنضجع (form VII)
# أَنْضَجِعُ (ʔanḍajiʕu) /ʔan.dˤa.d͡ʒi.ʕu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْضَجَعَ (inḍajaʕa)
# أَنْضَجِعَ (ʔanḍajiʕa) /ʔan.dˤa.d͡ʒi.ʕa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْضَجَعَ (inḍajaʕa)
# أَنْضَجِعْ (ʔanḍajiʕ) /ʔan.dˤa.d͡ʒiʕ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْضَجَعَ (inḍajaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
